title: Which Knowledge Should LLMs Trust? Uncovering a Generalizable Steering Direction Across Knowledge Conflicts
abstract: arXiv:2610.20067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently encounter conflicts between internal parametric knowledge and external contextual knowledge, yet the mechanisms governing this selection remain unclear. We show that the choice between context and parametric knowledge is linearly represented and can be controlled along a single direction in the model's residual stream. We first demonstrate that this direction generalizes across factual-conflict settings, including context formats, knowledge categories, and datasets, while consistently shifting behavior between parametric and contextual answers. We then transfer a direction learned from simple factual conflicts to three more complex task families: RAG, memory, and rule following, where models must acquire information from retrieved documents, interaction histories, or explicit rules. Across four model families and multiple transfer settings, steering consistently improves the use of prompt-provided

translated_title: 大语言模型应该信任哪种知识？揭示跨知识冲突的可泛化操控方向
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）经常遇到内部参数化知识与外部上下文知识之间的冲突，然而控制这种选择的机制仍不清楚。我们证明了在上下文与参数化知识之间的选择是线性表示的，并且可以沿着模型残差流中的单一方向进行控制。我们首先证明了这一方向能够在各种事实冲突设置中泛化，包括不同的上下文格式、知识类别和数据集，同时持续地在参数化答案和上下文答案之间转换模型行为。然后，我们将从简单事实冲突中学习到的方向迁移到三个更复杂的任务族：RAG（检索增强生成）、记忆和规则遵循，在这些任务中，模型必须从检索到的文档、交互历史或显式规则中获取信息。在四个模型族和多个迁移设置中，操控该方向持续地改善了对提示所提供信息
tldr: 研究发现大语言模型在参数化知识与上下文知识之间的选择沿残差流中单一方向线性表示，且该方向可跨任务泛化，通过操控该方向能有效改善模型在RAG、记忆和规则遵循任务中对提示信息的利用。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that LLMs' choice between parametric and contextual knowledge is linearly represented along a single direction in the residual stream, and this direction generalizes across tasks, with steering it consistently improving models' use of prompt-provided information in RAG, memory, and rule-following tasks.
